limitations: Only the remote RACP client wrapper and its admitted pairing/connect/close/reopen/reconnect paths are accepted. Full remote Host boot ownership, nineteen-family accounting and H1-H5 transfer remain incomplete.
The RACP tests use the in-memory MemoryLink and real RacpClient state machine; no real WebSocket Host, SSH server, stored Host or device token is contacted.
Ownership does not certify native-family closure of Node plugins, Electron utility processes, sockets or browser pages; bounded uncontained-resource evidence stays unqualified.
Voice development remains paused by explicit user direction and is not part of this acceptance.
No live Desktop/profile, provider/account, microphone, model, dependency installation, push, PR or remote merge was used.
